Definition
Source: topping:page-0108, topping:page-0109 1. ch9:4.1\group curvature-pinching Let $(\mathcal M,g(t))$ be a Ricci flow and $V\to \mathcal M$ a vector bundle with an initial bundle isomorphism $u_0:V\to T\mathcal M$ compatible with the initial metric. Define $u_t:V\to T\mathcal M$ by \[ \frac{\partial u}{\partial t}=\Ric _{g(t)}(u),\qquad u(0)=u_0, \] and define the induced connection $A(t)$ through \[ u(A_Xv)=\nabla _X(u(v)). \]
